name: Cra Page Shortcut Fixture
description: Made up for scripts/scenario.sh: the toolbar popup's shortcut is Command+Shift+Y, a ⌘ key Cra has no command for, as a user sets one for 'Activate the extension' in chrome://extensions/shortcuts (GitHub #744). Typed while a page has the keyboard it must still open the popup, which loads a fixture page to say it opened.
